title: Vibe coded a browser button football/soccer game in 30 minutes using weebit
author: elioengcomp
selftext:
Basically the title. 

The game uses the Carioca rule system, but with a reduced number of buttons and no out-of-bounds.

You can play it here: [https://weebitgames.com/elioengcomp/neno-super-button-soccer-deluxe](https://weebitgames.com/elioengcomp/neno-super-button-soccer-deluxe)

comments.author: Gusfoo
comments.body: Why does the power level go down the further you pull back instead of up?

replies.author: elioengcomp
replies.body: The idea is to give the player more precision if they use less power. Powerful shots travel longer distances, but should be harder to control. When I asked for that the AI came up with that solution where the aiming line gets longer if you use less power.

replies.author: Yhoshua_B
replies.body: Have you ever seen a pool game played on computer? This is the reverse of that. Not saying the idea is bad but the way the power is implemented is counter-intuitive to what people may be used to.

replies.author: elioengcomp
replies.body: I agree it is counterintuitive to drag longer and have less power, but having powerful shots as precise or even more precise than finesse shots is not realistic. In this case, I prefer the more realistic gameplay.
